generator.program.note: The program the authors chose to grow this taxon's decurrent tree species (named in each species' spec until G2.3a moved it here).

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 1926), families 117 Sterculiaceae, 119 Bombacaceae (the baobab) and 120 Malvaceae, which APG joins with the lindens as Malvaceae: leaves alternate, simple or digitate, mostly palmately veined; stipules present, often falling early; flowers regular; sepals (3-)5, joined, valvate, often with an epicalyx; petals 5; stamens many, often in a column; ovary superior; fruit a capsule, or splitting into its carpels (cocci).
